text: This report recommends a change in salary for the Chief Executive Officer of the Toronto Zoo, as well as an updated salary range.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the recommendations contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 30, 2023) from from Councillor Paul Ainslie, Dr. Cynthia Holmes, and Mr. Matthew Cole. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 30, 2023) from from Councillor Paul Ainslie, Dr. Cynthia Holmes, and Mr. Matthew Cole remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains information about labour relations and/or employee negotiations.
